sections.title: About me
paragraphs: I’m Youming. My work connects computer vision, geometry, and movement analysis. I’m interested in making complex motion easier to reconstruct, inspect, and understand.
My current work uses golf swings to explore reliable tracking, 3D reconstruction, and interpretable motion measurements from RGB video.
